title: My brain
examples: What part of my body helps me think?
Does my brain help me move my arms?
How does my brain know when I feel happy?

explain.say: Your brain is inside your head. It is in charge of your whole body.

draw.text: Brain: in charge of your body

explain.say: Your brain helps you think and learn new things.
Your brain helps you feel happy, sad or angry. All feelings are okay.
Your brain sends messages to your muscles. Then you can run and jump.
Your brain does all these jobs at the same time.
When you ride your bike, your brain tells your legs to pedal.

faq.q: What is the brain's main job?
faq.a: Your brain is in charge of your body. It sends messages that tell your body what to do.

faq.q: Does my brain help me feel things?
faq.a: Yes, the brain manages your feelings. It helps you know if you are happy or sad.
asks: Is feeling part of the brain's job?

faq.q: Does the brain only help me think?
faq.a: No, it also helps you move your body. It sends messages to your muscles.
asks: Can I move without my brain?

faq.q: Do I need to sleep for my brain?
faq.a: Yes, sleeping helps your brain rest and remember things you learned.
asks: Is sleep good for my brain?

faq.a: Your skull keeps your brain safe. Wear a helmet when you ride a bike or scooter.

facts: The brain controls all your actions and thoughts.
It helps you understand what you see and hear.
Feelings like joy and fear are managed by the brain.
Movement starts with signals from the brain.

quiz.why: Your brain is inside your head. Your skull keeps it safe.

wrong.0: Your chest holds your heart and lungs.
wrong.2: Your tummy holds the food you eat.

quiz.say: You learn a new word. Which job is your brain doing?
quiz.why: Learning new things is thinking. Your brain does the thinking.

wrong.1: Moving is when your brain tells your muscles to work.
wrong.2: Sleeping is when your brain rests, and here you are awake.

quiz.say: You want to jump high. What does your brain do?
quiz.show: 🦘 Jump. What does your brain do?

options.show: sends messages to your leg muscles
options.say: sends messages to your leg muscles

quiz.why: Your brain sends messages to your leg muscles. Then they pull and you jump.

wrong.0: Your legs grow slowly, so they stay the same length for a jump.
wrong.1: Jumping needs you awake, so your brain gets your muscles ready.
